Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The primary proteomics comparison is the presence vs absence of FVIII protein pulsing in dendritic cells. A secondary comparison is made between the peptide repertoires presented by different MHC-II molecules (HLA-DP vs HLA-DR). LPS is used as a maturation agent but the primary biological variable for the FVIII-specific results is the FVIII protein itself. For the ligand stimulation variable, no more specific child class (like cytokine or growth factor) fits FVIII (a coagulation factor), so the parent class is used.

Standard bottom-up pipelines (which assume tryptic digestion) are not suitable because the peptides are naturally processed by the MHC machinery and are not tryptic. A specialized immunopeptidomics pipeline (open search or specific MHC-peptide database search) is required.
